claim: For every field \(k\) and every \(r\)-dimensional \(k\)-vector space \(V\) with \(r\ge1\), the automorphism group scheme of \(A=k\oplus V\) with multiplication \((c,v)(d,w)=(cd,cw+dv)\) is \(\mathrm{GL}(V)\) when \(r\ge2\), is \(\mathbb G_m\) when \(r=1\) and \(\operatorname{char}k\ne2\), and when \(r=1\) and \(\operatorname{char}k=2\) is \(\operatorname{Spec}k[a,b,b^{-1}]/(a^2)\), parametrizing \(\varepsilon\mapsto a+b\varepsilon\); in the last case its reduced subgroup is \(\mathbb G_m\) but its tangent space at the identity has dimension \(2\), so it is non-smooth.

integrity.known_scope_boundary: The non-smooth case occurs exactly when \(\dim(V)=1\) and \(\operatorname{char}(k)=2\).
integrity.proof_type: self-contained symbolic proof over arbitrary commutative base algebras

limitations: Only split finite-dimensional commutative algebras \(A=k\oplus V\) with \(V^2=0\) are treated.
No classification is claimed for nonsplit local algebras, higher radical powers, or noncommutative algebras.
The literature comparison is bounded; universal novelty is not claimed.
title: Automorphism schemes of split square-zero local algebras
